blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — The city government of neighboring General Santos suspended classes at all levels and work in government offices on Thursday following a magnitude 6.4 earthquake that struck off Davao Occidental and was felt across parts of Mindanao. In a public advisory posted on their official social media page ‘LGU Gensan: Tatak Heneral’, the city government said the suspension of government work would allow authorities to conduct structural inspections and safety assessments of public buildings following the earthquake. Classes in all public and private schools were also suspended until further notice. READ: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake jolts Davao Occidental, parts of […]...
